description: Returns download links to one preset's two files, each with import steps. "tradingview": a flat settings file keyed by input label, for TradingView's Load Parameters. "hypernull": the HyperNull browser extension's preset file (name, strategy, instrument and timeframe included). The response is { preset_id, title, hypernull: { url, how_to_import }, tradingview: { url, how_to_import } }. It is the tool for loading a preset onto a chart; get_preset returns the values for reading or explaining. Links from the signed-in server expire after 15 minutes and re-check the license; links from the public server do not expire. Read-only.

preset_id.description: The preset_id of one preset, as returned by list_presets
